shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上画着安全帽和闪电，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with drawings of a hard hat and a lightning bolt, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全员面试，电气题怎么答？

shots.scene: 十三张空白问题卡排成两行
shots.prompt_en: Thirteen blank question cards arranged in two rows on a board. No people.
shots.narration: 今天一口气讲十三道题。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着衬衫，拿着空白简历，紧张地坐在面试室外
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a neat shirt holds a blank resume and sits nervously outside an interview room.
shots.narration: 阿杰要去面试安全员岗位。

shots.scene: 小研拿着一叠空白问题卡坐在他对面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits across from him holding a stack of blank question cards.
shots.narration: 小研帮他模拟一下面试。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起第一张空白问题卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the first blank question card.
shots.narration: 来，一题一题过。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起问题卡，卡上画着闪电问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card showing a lightning bolt icon and a question mark icon.
shots.narration: 第一问：电是什么，怎样工作？

shots.scene: 发电站图标通过电线连到一盏灯，箭头在线上流动
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power station connected by wires to a glowing lamp, with small arrows moving along the wire. No people.
shots.narration: 答：电是能量从一处流到另一处。

shots.scene: 发电站图标放大
shots.prompt_en: A large power station icon with cooling towers and transmission towers. No people.
shots.narration: 它的电源，是发电站。

shots.scene: 小圆点沿着导线绕成一个闭合的圈
shots.prompt_en: Small glowing dots travel along a wire that forms a closed loop around a battery and a bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 电子沿导体，在闭合回路里流动。

shots.scene: 白板左列六个空白词条
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with six blank term slots in a left column. No people.
shots.narration: 再答六个术语，先说电流和电路。

shots.scene: 导线中一串箭头整齐地向前移动，旁边有电流表图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of arrows moving forward inside a wire next to an ammeter icon with a needle. No people.
shots.narration: 电流是电的移动，单位安培。

shots.scene: 电源、导线、负载三个图标连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: A power source, a wire and a load group showing a lamp, a tool and a heater, connected in a full loop. No people.
shots.narration: 电路是完整路径：电源、导体、负载。

shots.scene: 导线中有一段变窄，小圆点在那里变慢
shots.prompt_en: A wire with a narrow section where the glowing dots slow down and bunch up. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻，是对电流的限制。

shots.scene: 铜线、铝条、钢钉图标，电流顺畅通过
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a copper wire, an aluminum bar and a steel nail with glowing dots flowing easily through them. No people.
shots.narration: 导体像金属，电阻小，电容易通过。

shots.scene: 设备金属外壳用一根绿黄线连到地下的接地符号
shots.prompt_en: The metal case of a machine is connected by a green and yellow wire to a ground symbol below the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 接地：导电部分连到大地，

shots.scene: 盾牌图标打勾，旁边接地符号
shots.prompt_en: A large shield icon with a green check mark and a small ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 是一种防触电的保护措施。

shots.scene: 玻璃、陶瓷、塑料、干木四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a glass, a porcelain insulator, a plastic tube and a dry wooden block in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 绝缘体：玻璃、陶瓷、塑料、干木，

shots.scene: 电线外包塑料皮，电流被挡在里面
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of an electric cable showing glowing dots kept inside by the plastic insulation layer. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻很高，不让电跑到别处。

shots.scene: 小研举起第二张问题卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the second blank question card.
shots.narration: 第二问：电气伤害有哪些？

shots.scene: 电击、烧伤、墓碑轮廓三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a person pictogram struck by a lightning bolt, a hand with a burn mark and a gravestone outline. No people.
shots.narration: 直接伤害：电击致死、电击、烧伤。

shots.scene: 梯子上的人形图标触电后跌落
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person pictogram on a ladder touching a wire with a small spark, then falling, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 间接伤害：触电后从高处摔下。

shots.scene: 小研举起第三张问题卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the third blank question card.
shots.narration: 第三问：电击有多严重？

shots.scene: 人体轮廓：电流从手进入，经躯干从脚流到接地金属
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline: current enters at one hand from a live wire, passes through the torso and exits at the foot into a grounded metal plate. No people.
shots.narration: 答：看路径、电流大小和持续时间。

shots.scene: 三个逐渐变大的电流箭头
shots.prompt_en: Three current arrows of increasing size next to a body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 比如30、40、100安培，越大越重。

shots.scene: 小插座图标旁有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A small wall socket icon with a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 注意：低电压不等于低危险。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 小研举起第四张问题卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the fourth blank question card.
shots.narration: 第四问：电流在体内怎么走？
overlay: 经过心脏的路径最危险

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 人体轮廓，心脏处发红
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with the heart highlighted in red. No people.
shots.narration: 最要命的，是经过心脏的路径。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 三个人体轮廓：手到手、手到脚、头到脚
shots.prompt_en: Three body outlines side by side with current lines: hand to hand, hand to foot, and head to foot, all crossing the heart. No people.
shots.narration: 手到手、手到脚、头到脚。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 电流从一只脚到另一只脚，心脏未高亮
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with a current line from one foot to the other, the heart not highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 脚到脚这类不经心脏的，影响小些。

shots.section_title: 电流对肌肉和心脏的作用
shots.scene: 小研举起第五张问题卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the fifth blank question card.
shots.narration: 第五问：电击有什么危险？
overlay: 电流对肌肉和心脏的作用

shots.section_title: 电流对肌肉和心脏的作用
shots.scene: 手握导线的图标，手臂肌肉发紧
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand gripping a wire, arm muscles drawn tense with zigzag lines. No people.
shots.narration: 超过10毫安，肌肉麻痹、僵住。

shots.section_title: 电流对肌肉和心脏的作用
shots.scene: 心电图线变得杂乱
shots.prompt_en: A heartbeat line icon that turns from regular waves into rapid chaotic zigzags. No people.
shots.narration: 超过75毫安，心脏快速无效跳动。

shots.scene: 时钟图标和警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 不用除颤器，几分钟内就会死亡。

shots.scene: 墙上的AED急救箱和打开的除颤器
shots.prompt_en: An automated external defibrillator cabinet on a wall and an open defibrillator case beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 心跳或呼吸停了，就用AED。

shots.scene: 小研举起第六张问题卡，白板分成两栏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the sixth blank question card in front of a whiteboard split into two columns.
shots.narration: 第六问：电气危害和防护措施。

shots.scene: 墙上乱拉的电线图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of messy tangled wires hanging along a wall, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 危害：布线不当，

shots.scene: 开关盒盖子掉了、露出铜线
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a switch box with its cover missing and bare copper wires exposed, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 电气部件外露，

shots.scene: 电线外皮开裂露出铜芯
shots.prompt_en: A close icon of a power cord with cracked insulation showing the copper core, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 电线绝缘不好。

shots.section_title: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具
shots.scene: 电动工具插头缺了接地脚
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power tool plug with its ground pin missing, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 系统和工具没接地，
overlay: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具

shots.section_title: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具
shots.scene: 一个插座接了一大堆负载冒热气
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one circuit feeding a large pile of machines, the wire glowing hot with heat waves. No people.
shots.narration: 电路过载，

shots.section_title: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具
shots.scene: 外壳开裂的电钻图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an electric drill with a cracked housing and a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 电动工具和设备损坏。

shots.section_title: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿
shots.scene: 不合适的手套和金属螺丝刀图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of thin cloth gloves and an uninsulated metal screwdriver with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 用错防护用品和工具，
overlay: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿

shots.section_title: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿
shots.scene: 高处的架空电线和一架金属梯子靠近
shots.prompt_en: An icon of overhead power lines on poles with a long metal ladder tilting close to them, red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 还有架空电力线。

shots.section_title: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿
shots.scene: 地面积水中放着插线板
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power strip lying in a puddle of water on the floor, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 潮湿时，所有危害都更严重。

shots.section_title: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿
shots.scene: 烧伤、电击、火焰、电弧四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a burn mark, an electric shock symbol, a flame and a bright arc spark. No people.
shots.narration: 后果：烧伤、电击、火灾爆炸、电弧。

shots.section_title: 防护：接地、漏电保护、熔断器
shots.scene: 设备外壳连接接地线，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A machine with its metal housing connected to a green and yellow ground wire, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 防护：正确接地，
overlay: 防护：接地、漏电保护、熔断器

shots.section_title: 防护：接地、漏电保护、熔断器
shots.scene: 带测试按钮的漏电保护器
shots.prompt_en: A residual current circuit breaker with a small test button inside an open distribution box. No people.
shots.narration: 用GFCI或ELCB，

shots.section_title: 防护：接地、漏电保护、熔断器
shots.scene: 熔断器和断路器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cartridge fuse and a miniature circuit breaker side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 用熔断器和断路器。

shots.section_title: 防护：遮挡带电部件、上锁挂牌
shots.scene: 接线端子被透明护罩罩住
shots.prompt_en: Electrical terminals covered by a clear protective cover with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 带电部件加遮护，
overlay: 防护：遮挡带电部件、上锁挂牌

shots.section_title: 防护：遮挡带电部件、上锁挂牌
shots.scene: 老李在断开的开关上挂锁和空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer attaches a padlock and a blank tag to a switched-off isolating switch.
shots.narration: 带电线路作业前，上锁挂牌。

shots.section_title: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿、培训
shots.scene: 完好的电源线和延长线整齐摆放
shots.prompt_en: An intact power cord and an extension cord neatly coiled and laid out, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 正确使用软线，
overlay: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿、培训

shots.section_title: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿、培训
shots.scene: 老李把配电柜门关好，前面有禁止靠近图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the door of a large electrical panel, with a no entry for unauthorized persons icon in front.
shots.narration: 配电柜门关好，无关的人碰不到。

shots.section_title: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿、培训
shots.scene: 雨天和积水图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of rain clouds and a wet floor puddle beside a power tool, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 避免潮湿条件作业，

shots.section_title: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿、培训
shots.scene: 王老师给一组学员讲课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a small group of trainees in front of a blank screen with an electric shock warning sign.
shots.narration: 带电作业的人，必须经过培训。

shots.scene: 小研举起第七张问题卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the seventh blank question card.
shots.narration: 第七问：什么是电气区域分类？

shots.scene: 三个方框，分别配大中小闪电
shots.prompt_en: Three boxes on the whiteboard, each with a large, medium or small lightning bolt icon. No people.
shots.narration: 答：分高压、中压、低压三类。

shots.scene: 大闪电方框旁贴上空白分类卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank classification card is attached next to the box with the large lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 一级一区，高压，650伏以上。

shots.scene: 中闪电方框旁贴上空白分类卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank classification card is attached next to the box with the medium lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 一级二区，中压，250到650伏。

shots.scene: 小闪电方框旁贴上空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: A blank card is attached next to the box with the small lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 非分类区，低压，250伏以下。

shots.scene: 小研举起第八张问题卡，两个相似的空白模块
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the eighth blank question card next to two similar blank breaker modules.
shots.narration: 第八问：ELCB和RCCB是什么？

shots.scene: 两个模块下方各有一张空白名牌
shots.prompt_en: Two blank breaker modules, each with a blank name plate beneath it. No people.
shots.narration: 接地漏电断路器和剩余电流断路器。

shots.scene: 旧模块被放进回收箱，新模块装上导轨
shots.prompt_en: An old style blank breaker module goes into a recycling bin while a new blank module clicks onto a mounting rail. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB是升级版，已基本取代ELCB。

shots.section_title: 电压型漏电保护器怎样动作
shots.scene: 小研举起第九张问题卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the ninth blank question card.
shots.narration: 第九问：ELCB怎样工作？
overlay: 电压型漏电保护器怎样动作

shots.section_title: 电压型漏电保护器怎样动作
shots.scene: 进线、出线、感测块示意，感测块连到设备外壳
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: incoming wires, outgoing wires and a blue sensing block wired to the metal case of a machine through a ground wire. No people.
shots.narration: 感测块接着设备外壳引来的地线。

shots.section_title: 电压型漏电保护器怎样动作
shots.scene: 相线碰到外壳，电流沿地线流过感测块
shots.prompt_en: A live wire touches the metal case, and glowing dots flow down the ground wire through the sensing block, which lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 相线碰壳，漏电经地线产生电压，

shots.section_title: 电压型漏电保护器怎样动作
shots.scene: 开关断开，设备灯灭
shots.prompt_en: The switch contacts open and the machine goes dark, separated from the power source. No people.
shots.narration: 触发脱扣，把故障和电源隔开。

shots.section_title: 电流型：进出电流比一比
shots.scene: 小研举起第十张问题卡，圆环中穿过两根线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the tenth blank question card next to a ring core with two wires through it.
shots.narration: 第十问：RCCB的作用？
overlay: 电流型：进出电流比一比

shots.section_title: 电流型：进出电流比一比
shots.scene: 圆环示意：相线和中性线一起穿过
shots.prompt_en: A ring shaped core with a red wire and a black wire passing together through its center, a relay and a test button beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 它靠零序电流互感器工作。

shots.section_title: 电流型：进出电流比一比
shots.scene: 两根线旁各有一个相同读数的电流表
shots.prompt_en: Two identical ammeter icons, one beside each wire, needles at the same position. No people.
shots.narration: 相线20安，中性线也回20安，

shots.section_title: 电流型：进出电流比一比
shots.scene: 天平平衡，圆环旁标零
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale perfectly level next to the ring core with a zero icon. No people.
shots.narration: 互感器里合成为零，不动作。

shots.section_title: 电流型：有人触电就跳闸
shots.scene: 手形图标碰到红线，小箭头经身体流向大地
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand touching the red wire, with a small arrow running through a body pictogram down to the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 有人碰到相线，电流从大地另走。
overlay: 电流型：有人触电就跳闸

shots.section_title: 电流型：有人触电就跳闸
shots.scene: 红线箭头变长，黑线箭头不变
shots.prompt_en: The arrow on the red wire grows longer while the black wire arrow stays the same. No people.
shots.narration: 相线20安加30毫安，中性线20安。

shots.section_title: 电流型：有人触电就跳闸
shots.scene: 圆环发亮，信号传到继电器，开关拨下
shots.prompt_en: The ring core glows, a signal travels to a relay coil, and the breaker lever flips down to off. No people.
shots.narration: 30毫安差值被检出，RCCB跳闸。

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器的区别
shots.scene: 小研举起第十一张问题卡，白板分左右两栏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the eleventh blank question card in front of a two-column board.
shots.narration: 第十一问：两者有什么区别？
overlay: 两种漏电保护器的区别

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器的区别
shots.scene: 左栏电压表图标，右栏电流表图标
shots.prompt_en: On the left a voltmeter icon, on the right an ammeter icon, separated by a line. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB电压型，RCCB电流型。

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器的区别
shots.scene: 右栏模块旁贴上第二张空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The module on the right gets an extra blank name tag attached. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB也叫RCD，剩余电流装置。

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器的区别
shots.scene: 左栏模块接地线完好打勾，右栏没有接地线也打勾
shots.prompt_en: On the left, the old module with an intact ground wire and a check; on the right, the new module without a ground wire also with a check. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB要好接地，RCCB不需要接地。

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器的区别
shots.scene: 左栏漏电绕过地线，模块不动；右栏漏电入地，模块跳闸
shots.prompt_en: On the left, leakage bypasses the ground wire and the old module stays on; on the right, leakage flows to the earth and the new module trips. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB漏电须经地线，RCCB入地就跳。

shots.scene: 小研举起第十二张问题卡，电钻图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the twelfth blank question card next to an electric drill icon.
shots.narration: 第十二问：电动工具有哪些危害？

shots.scene: 电击、火焰、火花、刀片四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an electric shock symbol, a flame with a burst, flying sparks and a saw blade. No people.
shots.narration: 电击、火灾爆炸、火花、割伤，

shots.scene: 烧伤、耳朵、抖动的手三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a burn mark on an arm, an ear with loud sound waves, and two hands with shaking lines. No people.
shots.narration: 还有烧伤、噪声和振动。

shots.section_title: 电动工具：漏保、松手即停、防护罩
shots.scene: 小研举起第十三张问题卡，工具插在带漏保的插座箱上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the thirteenth blank question card next to a power tool plugged into a site socket box with a residual current breaker.
shots.narration: 最后一问：预防措施。110伏供电，
overlay: 电动工具：漏保、松手即停、防护罩

shots.section_title: 电动工具：漏保、松手即停、防护罩
shots.scene: 插座箱上的漏电保护器特写
shots.prompt_en: A close view of the residual current breaker on the site socket box. No people.
shots.narration: 配30毫安ELCB。

shots.section_title: 电动工具：漏保、松手即停、防护罩
shots.scene: 手松开开关工具停转，角磨机护罩完好
shots.prompt_en: A hand releasing the trigger of a drill so it stops, next to an angle grinder with its guard in place. No people.
shots.narration: 松手即停开关，机器防护罩。

shots.section_title: 清除可燃物，砂轮转速要匹配
shots.scene: 作业区周围空无可燃物，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A top view of a work area surrounded by a clear empty zone, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 作业区没有可燃易燃物，
overlay: 清除可燃物，砂轮转速要匹配

shots.section_title: 清除可燃物，砂轮转速要匹配
shots.scene: 砂轮片和机器标签比大小
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a grinding disc with a blank rating label and a grinder with a blank rating label, greater-than symbol between them. No people.
shots.narration: 砂轮片转速要高于机器转速。

shots.section_title: 火花要挡住，灭火器材要备好
shots.scene: 作业区用挡板全部围起，火花被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A work area completely surrounded by fire resistant screens, sparks stopped inside. No people.
shots.narration: 火花百分之百封闭，飞不出来，
overlay: 火花要挡住，灭火器材要备好

shots.section_title: 火花要挡住，灭火器材要备好
shots.scene: 带挡帘的焊接棚
shots.prompt_en: An empty welding booth with flame resistant curtains in a workshop. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接设焊接棚，

shots.section_title: 火花要挡住，灭火器材要备好
shots.scene: 灭火器、灭火毯，老李在旁看火
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher and a fire blanket next to a work area, with the facility engineer standing watch.
shots.narration: 灭火器、灭火毯和受训的看火人。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴护目镜，再放下面罩
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles and then lowers a clear face shield over them.
shots.narration: 护目镜加面罩，双重护眼，

shots.scene: 皮手套、围裙、耳塞、耳罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of leather work gloves, an apron, foam ear plugs and ear muffs. No people.
shots.narration: 皮手套、围裙，耳塞或耳罩，

shots.scene: 时钟图标和两个人形图标交替
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with two person pictograms swapping places with circular arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 长时间作业要轮岗。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在十三张已翻开的问题卡前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of thirteen question cards, all turned over with check marks.
shots.narration: 十三道题，全部答完。

shots.scene: 闭合电路、人体心脏、AED三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a closed circuit, a body outline with the heart highlighted and a defibrillator. No people.
shots.narration: 电的原理、伤害、路径和AED。

shots.scene: 危害栏和防护栏两列图标
shots.prompt_en: Two columns of icons: hazard icons with warning triangles on the left and protection icons with checks on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 十类危害，十项防护。

shots.scene: 三个闪电方框和两个漏电保护模块
shots.prompt_en: Three lightning bolt boxes next to two blank breaker modules. No people.
shots.narration: 区域分类，ELCB和RCCB。

shots.scene: 电钻、挡板、护目镜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an electric drill, a fire resistant screen and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 电动工具的危害和预防。

shots.scene: 阿杰自信地走进面试室，欣欣在门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks confidently into the interview room while the panda mascot waves at the camera by the door.
shots.narration: 祝你面试顺利，下次见！
